results.reader_title: Adapting a circular-economy design framework for ICT service firms
results.reader_what: The BECE framework, adapted for services, helped a micro ICT firm identify and prioritise circular business models.
results.reader_more: BECE combines backcasting (working back from a desired future) with eco-design tools. The authors shifted it from products to users, adding the Business Model Canvas and a weighted evaluation matrix. Two workshops with a four-person Manchester ICT firm generated 20 actions; remote webcam support was adopted. Evidence comes from a single case.

deep_analysis.research_question: How can service-oriented ICT firms build circular economy business models?
deep_analysis.main_finding: The adapted BECE process produced usable circular business-model options for a micro ICT firm.
deep_analysis.method_or_basis: Two facilitated workshops applying BECE, Business Model Canvas and ReSOLVE checklist; post-workshop follow-up.
deep_analysis.qualification: One micro-firm; researchers facilitated; framework largely pre-existing.
deep_analysis.radar_relevance: Possible B method contribution (service adaptation of BECE) needing human judgement on novelty.
